# Python Patterns

Topic Markdown file (a Claude Code topic `*.md`). Tagged as `topic_memory` by
the Claude adapter (Story 2.2) — distinct from `MEMORY.md` so 2.3/2.4
filtering can separate the index from topic files.

## List comprehensions

Prefer comprehensions over `map`/`filter` for readability.

## Type hints

Always annotate public function signatures.
